mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : LogLrnActvDAO.mergeLrnActvInqHstry 설 명 : 학습활동조회이력 저장 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_LOG_LRN_ACTV_INQ_HSTRY HSTRY USING ( SELECT #{lrnActvId} AS LRN_ACTV_ID , USR.USER_ID , #{lrnActvTycd} AS LRN_ACTV_TYCD , #{orgnm} AS ORGNM , #{deptId} AS DEPT_ID , USR.STDNT_NO , USR.USERNM , FN_DTTM() AS INQ_DTTM , USR.USER_ID AS RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() AS REG_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_USER USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId} ) SRC ON ( HSTRY.LRN_ACTV_ID = SRC.LRN_ACTV_ID AND HSTRY.USER_ID = SRC.USER_ID ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LRN_ACTV_ID , USER_ID , LRN_ACTV_TYCD , ORGNM , DEPT_ID , STDNT_NO , USERNM , INQ_DTTM , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( SRC.LRN_ACTV_ID , SRC.USER_ID , SRC.LRN_ACTV_TYCD , SRC.ORGNM , SRC.DEPT_ID , SRC.STDNT_NO , SRC.USERNM , SRC.INQ_DTTM , SRC.RGTR_ID , SRC.REG_DTTM )
